Start

How long ago the Great Unknown crafted Solmaria, none know. The means by which it was wrought are also unknown. This is the way of the Great Unknown; to craft and to plan beyond the realm of our understanding.
伟大的不可知者于多久之前造就了索尔玛利亚，无人知晓。造就它的手段，同样无人知晓。这就是不可知者的行事之道：创造与筹划，皆超乎我们理解的疆界。
res#60466/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Start

Within the Unknown was Leunamar, and together they made eight beings of light. Their names were Solmaria, Baumonus, Tethrys, Gavitar, Gammon, Elypsus, Miala and Azros.

	Each spirit was paired with another to work. To Solmaria was given Baumonus; to Tethrys, Gavitar; to Gammon, Elypsus; and to Miala, Azros.

不可知者之中有卢纳玛尔，他们共同造出了八个光之存在。它们的名字是：索尔玛利亚、鲍莫努斯、泰丝瑞斯、加维塔、加蒙、埃利普苏斯、米亚拉与阿兹罗斯。

	每个灵都有一位同伴与之共事。索尔玛利亚配予鲍莫努斯；泰丝瑞斯配予加维塔；加蒙配予埃利普苏斯；米亚拉则配予阿兹罗斯。
res#60466/whatIHaveToSay[2]
Start

The pairs worked to create expressions of themselves, as they themselves were expressions of the Great Unknown.

	In time, the worlds formed, and the spirits rested in that which they had made; their purpose complete, and their work done.

成对的灵共同创造，造出自身的表达，正如它们自身，也是不可知者的表达。

	终于，诸世界成形，众灵安歇于自己的造物之中；使命已竟，功业已成。
res#60466/whatIHaveToSay[3]
Start

They became the hearts of their worlds, and took great joy in watching things unfold, but were forbidden to intervene. Azros was not content to watch only, and wished to rule and to command those that walked upon his world.

	Neither did he accept that they might praise the Great Unknown instead of himself.

它们成了各自世界的心脏，看万物演变，乐在其中，却被禁止干预。阿兹罗斯不满足于旁观，他想要统治、想要号令行走于他的世界上的生灵。

	他也无法接受：那些生灵竟然可能赞颂不可知者，而不是赞颂他自己。
res#60466/whatIHaveToSay[4]
Start

He refused to watch over his world, and instead set his efforts to control it. A fight ensued between him and Miala, a struggle lasting for time untold. At last, Azros found a way out of his bondage, and struck at Miala with such a blow that the world was rent apart, casting Azros into the void.
他拒绝守望自己的世界，反而倾力去控制它。他与米亚拉之间爆发了争斗，这场较量持续了无从计数的岁月。最终，阿兹罗斯找到了挣脱束缚的方法，向米亚拉发出了雷霆一击，世界被撕裂，阿兹罗斯也被抛入虚空。
res#60466/whatIHaveToSay[5]
Start

He drifted until he came upon Solmaria and Baumonus. Descending to their world he interfered in the affairs and workings of man and nature. Baumonus, seeing this, desired such action for himself, as did Gavitar and Elypsus. 
 
	Struggles began on each world, casting their survival into question.

他漂泊游荡，直到遇见索尔玛利亚与鲍莫努斯。他降入他们的世界，插手人类与自然的事务与运作。鲍莫努斯见状，也起了同样的念头；加维塔与埃利普苏斯亦然。 
 
	于是各个世界上都燃起了争斗，世界的存续都成了疑问。
res#60466/whatIHaveToSay[6]
Start

But the others could not break free, and were bound. Their titles were stripped from them. The Great Unknown sent a spirit to replace them, and their worlds became known by the spirits that held to their purpose: Solmaria, Tethrys, Gammon and Miala.

Azros was still free, but found that without Miala he had abandoned a great deal of his power, for it was in unity that he was great.

但其余诸灵未能挣脱，皆被束缚。它们的名号被剥夺。不可知者另遣灵来替代它们，它们的世界从此以坚守使命的灵为名：索尔玛利亚、泰丝瑞斯、加蒙与米亚拉。

阿兹罗斯仍然自由，却发现失去了米亚拉，他便舍弃了自身大半的力量，因为他的伟大，正在于合一。
res#60466/whatIHaveToSay[7]
Start
Enraged, he set out to conquer the world of Solmaria. Thus began the reign of Azros, the dark lord.
他狂怒不已，誓要征服索尔玛利亚的世界。阿兹罗斯（黑暗领主）的统治就此开始。
